participant_id.Description: BIDS subject label; equal to the DANDI subject label of DANDI 000940 (sub-2 ... sub-17).

age.Description: Age at the recording, from NWB general/subject/age (ISO 8601 duration, years).

recording_institution.Description: NWB general/institution of the session (hospital where the patient was recorded).

dandi_subject_id.Description: NWB general/subject/subject_id in the source file.
